lauren_pm: Heads up — need quick alignment on model capability discovery endpoint & capability flags before next sprint planning. Customers are pushing for clear answers on tool support, streaming JSON outputs, and token limits. Can we surface a minimal discovery contract we can ship as a beta? TL;DR: small JSON schema + flags to start.

sam_eng_api: Quick Q — single /v1/models/:id/capabilities or a top-level /v1/capabilities listing all models? Single endpoint per-model is simpler for rollout and versioning.

eva_ml: From model-onboarding POV we need: max_tokens, streaming_supported, tool_calling: [tool_ids], structured_output_schema (optional URL), quantized_variants, and per_model_token_budget. Also include model_version and deprecation_date.

mike_devex: We should also expose runtime_profiles array with latency/cost buckets so SDKs can pick a variant. Example snippet: ```json
{
  "id":"gptx-8q",
  "flags":["stream","functions","structured_json"],
  "max_tokens":4096,
  "embedding_dims":1024
}
```

natalie_sales: Customer ask: surface "supports_rerank" and "embedding_dims" so enterprise teams can route requests to the right model. Also want a "guaranteed_slo" boolean for Dedicated customers.

sam_eng_api: For launch criteria proposal: 1) endpoint returns stable v1 schema, 2) SDKs can parse flags and provide fallbacks, 3) integration tests for streaming + tool-calling, 4) clear behavior when token limits are exceeded (error vs truncated). Agree?

lauren_pm: :thumbsup: Agree. Prioritization: beta = hosted API only (no Private/Dedicated in beta). Dedicated and Private discovery contracts in next quarter. Who owns the schema + backward compat guarantees?

eva_ml: I can own the schema and model-side annotations (annotations in model manifest). Eng API owns the endpoint shape and compatibility rules. DevEx will own SDK parsing and migration docs.

mike_devex: SDK changes: add Model.capabilities field and helpers like is_streaming_supported(), get_tools(), preferred_runtime_profile(). We'll add a migration guide and small UI helpers for the Console.

sam_eng_api: Edge cases: what if model reports streaming:true but runtime can't provide chunked responses? Propose discovery include optional "fallback_model" and "fallback_behavior" (e.g., "buffer_and_send", "reject").

lauren_pm: Launch checklist (draft): minimal fields (flags list, max_tokens, streaming, tools array, structured_output_url, embedding_dims), integration tests, migration guide, prod telemetry for unknown flags, Console UI update, and a canary rollout. Target: ship beta in 3 sprints.

opsbot: deploy-bot: new route created in staging: POST /v1/models/{id}/capabilities (schema stubs added). Tests pending.

natalie_sales: Also add a compliance-related flag: "no_pii_mode" or "data_disallow_extensions" — customers in regulated industries want an explicit guarantee surface.

sam_eng_api: Token limits specifics: separate per-request max_tokens and a rolling-window token_budget (e.g., monthly). Default budget for hosted free tier = 1e6 tokens/month unless contract overrides. Also need clear error code for budget_exceeded.

mike_devex: Tool descriptor should be standardized so SDKs and Console can render UIs: {id, name, schema_url, auth_requirements, allowed_roles}. If we include schema_url we can display structured_output examples.

lauren_pm: OK — next steps: @eva_ml spec PR by EOD Wed, @sam_eng_api prototype endpoint in staging by Friday, @mike_devex SDK stub & migration doc next week. I'll capture launch criteria and add to roadmap. Thanks all.

sam_eng_api: :raised_hands: thanks, will push prototype.

mike_devex: noted, will start SDK changes and add sample code for fallback.

eva_ml: I'll upload the initial JSON schema PR and include example discovery payloads and tests.

lauren_pm: If anyone has critical missing fields call them out here. Otherwise I'll create the GH issue and link owners.

mike_devex: one more — add "supported_stream_encodings" (e.g., ["json-seq","text/event-stream"]) so clients know how to parse.

eva_ml: good catch. adding to spec.

lauren_pm: Great. Closing thread for now — will post links to PRs + roadmap item when created.
